entries.msgstr: The old Thunderbolt. Owns every patch of dirt under it. Power unit was von Krieger's work, bolted in by the man himself. Good work it was, too—still runs like the day it left the bench. Now, every fight, I get to pay him back with his own brilliance. The job used to be simple: stop him, wreck his plan, go home. But this year it's different. He's playing with something he might not be able to put back in the box. Says he can, but I'm not sure he believes himself. Either way, time to shove the madman back into his hole. With his own engine driving.
Major modernization of the main battle tank
Each overloaded Generator will charge Silver Bullet with Plasma. The more Charges, the more damage Plasma causes. Shoot when the Blitzträger's shield is down for maximum damage.
